summary_en: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 raised the tender offer price to 2,270 yen per share from 2,250 yen, extended the offer period to October 5, 2026 (41 business days), and reduced the target share count to 10,644,725 shares (63.72% of outstanding shares) with a minimum of 5,049,300 shares (30.23%), following a non-tender agreement with Hikaritsuushin KK and affiliated parties. The board maintained its recommendation for shareholders to tender.
title_en: Partial Amendment to the Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation to Tender
translation_en_brief:
Japan Property Management Center's board announced amendments to the tender offer by Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 on September 15, 2026. The bidders increased the per-share price to 2,270 yen from the previously announced 2,250 yen. The tender period was extended by 11 business days to October 5, 2026, making a total of 41 business days. The target share count was adjusted to 10,644,725 shares, representing 63.72% of outstanding shares, with a minimum threshold of 5,049,300 shares (30.23% of outstanding shares).

These changes followed a non-tender agreement executed on September 14, 2026, with major shareholders including Hikaritsuushin KK investment partnership, UH Partners 2 investment partnership, Hikaritsuushin Co., Ltd., and Hikari Tsushin Investments Okinawa Co., Ltd. Under the agreement, Hikaritsuushin KK and UH Partners 2 committed to distributing 1,452,100 shares (8.69% of outstanding shares) to Hikari Tsushin Investments Okinawa, which would then be acquired by the company as treasury shares. The remaining 206,400 shares held by these parties would not be tendered.

The board of directors reaffirmed its support for the tender offer and continued to recommend that shareholders tender their shares at the new terms.
